title: The Council Tax Reduction (Miscellaneous Amendment) (No. 2) (Scotland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the Council Tax Reduction (State Pension Credit) (Scotland) Regulations 2012 (“the 2012 Regulations”) and the Council Tax Reduction (Scotland) Regulations 2021 (“the 2021 Regulations”). Regulation 2 amends the 2012 Regulations and regulation 3 amends the 2021 Regulations.

title: The Children (Care, Care Experience and Services Planning) (Scotland) Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring provisions of the Children (Care, Care Experience and Services Planning) (Scotland) Act 2026 (“the Act”) into force. The Bill for the Act received Royal Assent on 15 May 2026. By virtue of section 70 of the Act, that section together with sections 67, 68 and 71 came into force on 16 May 2026.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Middlesborough) (No. 5) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Longleat) Regulations 2026
The Renewable Heat Incentive Scheme (Closure) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations close the renewable heat incentive scheme established by the Renewable Heat Incentive Scheme Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2012 (S.R. 2012/396) (“the 2012 Regulations”). They convert existing eligible installations to a closure scheme providing annual closure payments for the remainder of their original tariff lifetimes.

title: The Free Zone (Customs Site No. 2 Freeport East) Designation Order 2026
summary: This Order designates the Customs Site No. 2 Freeport East as a special area for customs purposes (a “free zone”) and appoints Assan Panel UK Limited as the responsible authority for the free zone designated by this Order pursuant to the Treasury’s powers under section 100A of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 (“CEMA”).

title: The Tobacco and Vapes Act 2026 (Age of Sale Notices and Consequential Amendments) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: Section 1 of the Tobacco and Vapes Act 2026 (c. 18) (“the 2026 Act”) changes the required age at which an individual can legally be sold tobacco products from 18 years or over, to having been born before 1 January 2009. Under section 5(1) of the 2026 Act tobacco retailers in England must display a notice on their premises which contains the statement in section 5(2) to reflect the new age of sale requirement. Regulation 3 prescribes the minimum size requirements for such a notice and regulation

title: The Sentencing Act 2020 (Special Procedures for Community and Suspended Sentence Orders) Regulations 2026
summary: The Sentencing Act 2020 (c. 17), as amended by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 (c. 32), makes provision for special procedures to apply to community orders and suspended sentence orders in certain cases.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Sutton Scotney, Hampshire) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records) Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/233).

title: The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Jersey) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Jersey) Regulations 2010 (S.I. 2010/1087).

title: The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Isle of Man) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Isle of Man) Regulations 2011 (S.I. 2011/2296).

title: The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Guernsey) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Guernsey) Regulations 2009 (S.I. 2009/3297).

title: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Emissions and Verification) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the introduction of a new tax called the carbon border adjustment mechanism (“CBAM”). CBAM was introduced by the Finance Act 2026.

title: The Access to the Countryside (Coastal Margin) (Isle of Wight) (No. 3) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the day on which the access preparation ends in relation to land which is coastal margin as a result of the approval by the Secretary of State of proposals contained in reports relating to coastal access along the long-distance route on the Isle of Wight. Copies of the notices of approval are available at www.gov.uk and may also be obtained by writing to the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Seacole Building, 2 Marsham Street, London SW1 4DF.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Middlesborough) (No. 4) Regulations 2026
The Energy Prices Act 2022 (Extension of Time Limit) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary:
Section 13 of the 
Energy Prices Act 2022 (c. 44) (“the Act”) confers powers on the Secretary of State to provide support for meeting energy costs.

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations set out the transitional and savings provisions relating to members of the Local Government Pension Scheme 2009 (“the 2009 Scheme”) which is to be replaced by a new Local Government Pension Scheme by the Local Government Pension Scheme (Scotland) Regulations 2014 (SSI 2014/164) with effect from 1st April 2015 (“the 2015 Scheme”). Their effect is to protect the benefits accrued by members of the 2009 Scheme before 1st April 2015.

title: The Finance Act 2009, Sections 101 and 102 (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism) (Interest) (Appointed Day) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints 1st January 2027 as the day on which sections 101 and 102 of the Finance Act 2009 come into force for the purposes of the carbon border adjustment mechanism.

title: The Warm Home Discount (Reconciliation) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Warm Home Discount (Reconciliation) Regulations 2022 (“the Reconciliation Regulations”).
